description: Veloce GBA core authoritative test suite. Subsystem-organized, prioritized, with per-test result-detection. Goal: state with evidence how architecturally correct AND cycle-accurate the GBA core is. Detection: every verdict comes from the VELOCE-RESULT/1 file the app writes to VELOCE_TEST_OUT. jsmolka/alyosha/FuzzARM ROMs park in a 'b .' loop with R12 = failing test # (0 = pass); the Veloce GBA plugin's r12 adapter turns that into 'END 1/1' / 'END 0/1 code=<n>' in the file ('serial' is a deprecated alias of 'file'). ROMs that print through the mGBA debug registers write their own lines (mgba channel). Visual ROMs are captured via SAVE_SCREENSHOT and CRC32-compared. Interactive ROMs (mGBA suite, armwrestler) have no headless auto-verdict and are marked known_fail/RUNS until a screenshot reference is pinned.

jsmolka.description: Canonical CPU (ARM/Thumb), memory, BIOS, PPU smoke, save-type tests. Fail # in R12.

nba-hw-test.description: NanoBoyAdvance hardware tests (moved from GitHub to Codeberg in 2026; the GitHub repo is archived). The scored ROMs run as rom_variant veloce rebuilds (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test, veloce/nba_hw_test/*); this clone only supplies the unmodified ppu/bgpd and ppu/bgx for visual_test_suites.

fuzzarm.description: Randomized 10k-iteration ARM/Thumb instruction fuzz ROMs (prebuilt .gba). On-screen pass/fail.

armwrestler.description: ARMWrestler ALU + multi load/store correctness ROM (interactive, on-screen).

cpu_arm.name: ARM Instruction Set
cpu_arm.description: ARM mode: conditions, branches, flags, shifts, data processing, PSR transfer, multiply, single/halfword transfer, swap, block transfer (LDM/STM). Spans ~600 sub-tests; fail # in R12.

tests.notes: Comprehensive ARM instruction correctness. R12=0 on full pass.

cpu_thumb.name: Thumb Instruction Set
cpu_thumb.description: Thumb mode: all 19 formats incl. BLX, PUSH/POP edge cases, hi-reg ops, conditional/unconditional branch. Fail # in R12.

tests.notes: Comprehensive Thumb instruction correctness. R12=0 on full pass.

cpu_psr.name: PSR / CPSR-SPSR
cpu_psr.description: Program status register transfer/banking (MRS/MSR, mode switches, SPSR per mode, flag bits).

cpu_ldm.name: LDM/STM Block Transfer Edge Cases
cpu_ldm.description: Load/store-multiple corner cases that break naive cores: base-in-list writeback, PC in list (mode/Thumb switch), S-bit banked transfer, LDM combined with ALU/MUL/SWP/BX.

tests.notes: LDM followed by ALU op (timing/value interaction).
LDM loading PC then BX (ARM/Thumb state switch).
LDM interleaved with SWP (bus locking).

cpu_alyosha_core.name: Alyosha ARM/Thumb Core (cross-check)
cpu_alyosha_core.description: Independent ARM/Thumb correctness ROMs from the alyosha fork plus targeted Thumb edge ROMs (BLX, CPY, PUSH/POP with no regs).

tests.notes: Thumb BLX(2) reg form.
PUSH with empty reg list: SP -= 0x40 quirk.
POP with empty reg list: SP += 0x40, PC loaded from [SP] quirk.

cpu_fuzz.name: FuzzARM Randomized CPU Fuzz
cpu_fuzz.description: DenSinH/FuzzARM: 10k randomized iterations per ROM covering ARM/Thumb data-processing and all-type ops, cross-checked against a reference. On-screen pass/fail (no R12 spin); headless verdict not auto-extractable yet so marked known_fail pending a screenshot reference or a debug-string build.

tests.notes: 10k ARM data-processing fuzz. Reports on screen; needs OCR/screenshot ref for headless verdict.
10k ARM all-type fuzz.
10k Thumb data-processing fuzz.
10k Thumb all-type fuzz.
10k any-mode any-type fuzz.

cpu_armwrestler.name: ARMWrestler ALU + Load/Store
cpu_armwrestler.description: destoer armwrestler-gba-fixed: ARM ALU and the notoriously tricky multiple load/store (test4) cases. Interactive menu ROM; no headless verdict, captured as a visual smoke / RUNS.

tests.notes: Interactive; spins waiting for input. Document as manual-only until a pinned screenshot reference exists.

memory_access.name: Memory Map / Mirroring / Width
memory_access.description: Region mirroring (IWRAM/EWRAM/Palette/VRAM/OAM), 8/16/32-bit access width, misaligned access rotation, BIOS/IO open-bus reads.

memory_alyosha.name: Memory (alyosha cross-check)
memory_alyosha.description: Independent memory access/mirroring ROM from the alyosha fork.

memory_bus.name: Bus / Boundary Crossing
memory_bus.description: LDM and DMA (incrementing/decrementing) timing across memory-region and 128 KiB cartridge-ROM page boundaries (0x07FFFFF8 into ROM, 0x0801FFF8, 0x0803FFF8), where the next access is forced non-sequential.

tests.notes: rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. 18 checks: LDM, DMA INC and DMA DEC at six addresses each. The measured time() routine is pinned to the shipped binary's instruction sequence (see PROVENANCE.md).

memory_unsafe.name: Unsafe / Undefined Memory
memory_unsafe.description: SRAM mirroring and unused-ROM (out-of-bounds) open-bus reads. Behavior is board-dependent; not guaranteed on hardware.

tests.notes: Intentionally exercises undefined behavior; documented known_fail.

prefetch.name: ROM Prefetch Buffer
prefetch.description: Cartridge prefetch buffer: 8-word FIFO fill, sequential/non-sequential cost, boundary crossings, branch-into-prefetch interactions in ARM and Thumb, prefetch + DMA contention. The single biggest cycle-accuracy lever for ROM-resident game timing.

tests.notes: Prefetch buffer vs DMA bus contention.

timing_cpu_mem.name: CPU / Memory Access Timing
timing_cpu_mem.description: Per-access cycle cost of code/data fetches from BIOS, ROM and IWRAM with and without prefetch enabled; DMA-from-BIOS and long-DMA cycle accounting.

tests.notes: Copy timing executing from/through BIOS region.
WAITCNT prefetch-enable cycle effect.

timing_irq.name: IRQ Latency & Pipeline
timing_irq.description: Interrupt entry latency relative to BL/branch, R14_irq value on entry, HALT wake PC, IE/IF/IME gating, timer-driven IF, slow vs fast IRQ handlers.

tests.notes: IRQ taken during BL: correct return address.
R14_irq exact value when IRQ interrupts BL.
PC after HALT wake.
IF acknowledge (write-1-to-clear) semantics.

timing_irq_nba.name: IRQ Delay (NanoBoyAdvance)
timing_irq_nba.description: Hardware-measured 1-instruction IRQ pipeline delay between IF set and handler entry.

tests.notes: rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. IRQ TIME from IWRAM, EWRAM and ROM.

timing_dma.name: DMA Cycle Behavior
timing_dma.description: DMA mode-change latching, fixed source/dest addressing, pause/resume timing at transfer start/mid/end, ROM->IWRAM transfers.

tests.notes: Rewriting DMA control mid-flight; latch vs live.

timing_dma_nba.name: DMA Hardware Tests (NanoBoyAdvance)
timing_dma_nba.description: Latch of source/dest/count, start-delay (DMA does not begin same cycle), forced non-sequential first access, large burst transfers.

tests.notes: rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. Per-channel DMA data latch and open bus (DMA LATCH 0/1/2, BUS LATCH).

rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. Immediate DMA start delay measured with TM0 (IMM).

rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. First DMA access forced non-sequential (EWRAM DMA, ROM DMA).

rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. DMA3 from IWRAM end into ROM with decrementing destination: two data values and the transfer time.

timing_fifo_dma.name: Audio FIFO DMA
timing_fifo_dma.description: Sound FIFO (DMA1/DMA2 special timing mode) feeding the Direct Sound A/B FIFOs on timer overflow; refill cadence and 4-word transfer behavior.

timing_timer.name: Timer Counter / Cascade
timing_timer.description: 16-bit timer count-up, prescaler selection, reload-on-overflow, enable/disable mid-count, cascade chaining, overflow IRQ edge.

tests.notes: Disabling a running timer mid-tick.
Reload register vs current counter latch.

timing_timer_nba.name: Timer Hardware Tests (NanoBoyAdvance)
timing_timer_nba.description: Exact start/stop cycle and reload-on-overflow timing measured on hardware.

tests.notes: rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. Timer start and stop latency (1ST, 2ND).

rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. Reload on overflow and reload-register overwrites with 16/32-bit stores at different cycles.

timing_haltcnt.name: HALTCNT / Power Management
timing_haltcnt.description: HALTCNT (0x4000301) HALT vs STOP, wake-on-enabled-IRQ, IME-independent HALT wake.

tests.notes: rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. HALT entered directly, through CpuSet and through DMA, POSTFLG preserved, and HALT with an IRQ already pending from IWRAM and ROM. The HALTCNT CPUSET DMA window is pinned to the shipped binary's instruction sequence (see PROVENANCE.md).

timing_interactions.name: HALT/DMA/IRQ/Timer Interactions
timing_interactions.description: The hardest cross-subsystem cycle-accuracy cases: an IRQ arriving while HALTed and/or while a DMA or internal-cycle (MUL/branch) is in flight, OAM read during the resulting handler, IWRAM vs ROM fetch interplay. Stresses the scheduler ordering.

tests.notes: Internal MUL cycles overlapping DMA.

ppu_smoke.name: PPU Smoke (jsmolka)
ppu_smoke.description: Basic bring-up: mode-3/4 hello bitmap, palette shades, tiled stripes. Confirms the render path produces output at all.

ppu_timing.name: PPU Sub-Scanline / Startup Timing
ppu_timing.description: Sub-scanline-accurate PPU behavior: power-on/VBlank start state, VBlank IRQ + HALT startup sequencing, sprite disable mid-scanline, sprite VRAM-access windows (the OBJ fetch cutoff each line). These are the cases that drive mid-frame raster effects.

tests.notes: BGxHOFS mid-line scroll.
PPU register state at power-on.
Toggling OBJ enable mid-scanline.
Cycle of the final OBJ VRAM fetch per line.

ppu_status_dma.name: PPU DISPSTAT IRQ / HBlank DMA
ppu_status_dma.description: DISPSTAT VBlank/HBlank/VCount flag and IRQ generation interacting with HBlank-triggered DMA. Requires sub-scanline accuracy; commonly the first thing to fail on a scanline renderer.

tests.notes: rom_variant veloce: rebuilt by tests/roms-src/build.py gba/nba_hw_test from the pinned Codeberg source with the Veloce patch that reports every check as a CHECK line over the mGBA debug registers (tests/roms-src/gba/nba_hw_test/PROVENANCE.md); without the build this test SKIPs. The upstream ROM is a menu; the Veloce patch runs its four pages (DISPSTAT, VCOUNT, IF, DMA) once, unattended, and emits one TEST group per page. Each page searches up to 1232 cycle offsets at about one frame per offset, so a correct core needs ~2900 frames and one whose flags never change up to ~6200; frames 6500 covers both (the reason timeout_seconds is 180, not 60: the frame budget, not wall time, is what ends a slow run). Needs sub-scanline DISPSTAT timing; flagged known_fail until the catch-up renderer is cycle-exact.

bios.name: BIOS SWI Functions
bios.description: BIOS software-interrupt routines: arithmetic (Div/Sqrt/ArcTan), CpuSet/CpuFastSet, BG/OBJ affine matrix, decompression (LZ77/Huffman/RL/Diff), and HLE-vs-real BIOS behavior.

tests.notes: Requires either real BIOS or an accurate HLE of the SWI math/decompression routines.

bios_alyosha.name: BIOS (alyosha cross-check)
bios_alyosha.description: Independent BIOS SWI ROM from the alyosha fork.

save.name: Cartridge Save Backends
save.description: Save-type autodetection and read/write/erase for SRAM (32KB), Flash 64KB (single-bank) and 128KB (banked, with bank-switch command), and EEPROM/none. Exercises the cartridge backup memory interface and command sequences.

tests.notes: 32KB battery SRAM.
64KB Flash, erase/program command sequence.
128KB Flash with bank switching.
No backup memory present (open-bus on save region).

ppu_affine_visual.name: PPU Affine BG (visual, non-scoring)
ppu_affine_visual.description: When BG2PD and BG2X written mid-frame by H-blank DMA are latched for the next scanline. Both registers are write-only and the ROMs assert nothing: their only result is the rendered picture (upstream's expected.png), which no CPU-readable register exposes. Kept as upstream binaries for manual/visual comparison; they never score (docs/testing/VELOCE-RESULT.md, section 4).

tests.notes: BG2PD latch timing. Non-scoring: compare against upstream ppu/bgpd/expected.png by eye. The CPU-observable part of affine-register latching belongs to the planned gba_ppu_readback_and_latch ROM (GBA-11).
BG2X reference-point latch timing. Non-scoring: compare against upstream ppu/bgx/expected.png by eye (see ppu/bgpd).

known_issues.ppu_sub_scanline: DISPSTAT HBlank IRQ + HBlank DMA (ppu_status_dma) needs a cycle-exact / sub-scanline PPU and is marked known_fail until the catch-up renderer is verified cycle-accurate. BGxX/BGxPD affine latching (visual_test_suites.ppu_affine_visual) has no CPU-readable result and never scores.
known_issues.fuzzarm_armwrestler: FuzzARM and ARMWrestler report pass/fail by drawing to the framebuffer, not by spinning with R12. There is no headless auto-verdict path today, so they are marked known_fail. To score them: capture a known-good screenshot reference and switch them to screenshot-crc, or rebuild with an mGBA-debug-string-printing harness.
known_issues.mgba_suite_excluded: mgba-emu/suite (suite.gba) is an interactive menu-driven ROM with no headless pass/fail signal; deliberately not in the run set. Run it manually for spot checks of timing/IO/BIOS-math/shifter sections.
known_issues.ags_excluded: The AGS aging cartridge is Nintendo proprietary diagnostic firmware and is not redistributable; cannot be included. Documented for completeness only.
known_issues.real_bios_dependency: BIOS SWI tests assume an accurate BIOS (real dump or faithful HLE). If the core HLEs only a subset of SWIs, bios.gba will report the first unimplemented call.

_legacy_arm_test_ranges._comment: Documentation only: jsmolka arm.gba sub-test number ranges, useful for mapping an R12 failing-test # to the offending instruction class.

_debug_output._comment: mGBA-compatible debug registers the Veloce GBA bus implements for ROM text output.
